state.seed_assertion: Innovative technology refers to new developments in technological knowledge at large rather than technology that is new only to the controller.

sentences.1: Innovative technology refers to new developments in technological knowledge at large rather than technology that is new only to the controller.
sentences.2: Recital 91 says innovative technology concerns new developments in technological knowledge in the world at large, rather than technology that is new to you
sentences.3: The ICO requires DPIAs for use of innovative technology combined with criteria from European guidelines.

sentences.5: Innovative technology refers to new developments in technological knowledge in the world at large, rather than technology that is new to the individual organization.
sentences.6: Recital 91 says innovative technology concerns new developments in technological knowledge in the world at large, rather than technology that is new to you, and its use can trigger the need to carry out a DPIA.
sentences.7: Innovative technology requires a DPIA in combination with another criterion from European guidelines according to the ICO list.
